brief:
Hossam Badran, head of Hamas's national relations office, held a telephone call with Anwar Raja, deputy secretary-general of the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine–General Command, Shehab Wire reported. The two discussed recent serious developments affecting Palestinian territories, the ongoing Israeli aggression against the Palestinian population, and what the statement described as continuous violations by Israeli forces.

The conversation reflected efforts by the Palestinian factions to coordinate positions on political and military matters. The call touched on electoral processes and the evolving situation across Palestinian areas amid the escalating conflict. Both parties are part of broader Palestinian political movements that have historically held separate positions on armed resistance and political strategy.
